<style>
/* ===== TOOLTIP STYLES ===== */
.tooltip {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
}
.tooltip .tooltiptext {
  visibility: hidden;
  width: 300px;
  background-color: #f7f5cc;
  color: black;
  font-size: 15px;
  text-align: left;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 8px 15px 8px 8px;
  box-shadow: 3px 3px 3px #333333;
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 1;
  top: 0px;
  left: 105%;
}
.tooltip:hover .tooltiptext {
  visibility: visible;
}
.tooltip .tooltiptext2 {
  visibility: hidden;
  width: 500px;
  background-color: #f7f5cc;
  color: black;
  font-size: 15px;
  text-align: left;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 8px 15px 8px 8px;
  box-shadow: 3px 3px 3px #333333;
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 1;
  margin-left: -520px;
  margin-top: 10px;
}
.tooltip:hover .tooltiptext2 {
  visibility: visible;
}

/* ===== LIST HOVER STYLES ===== */
/* 1. Flatten border mapping globally */
.listHover,
.listHover table,
.listHover tbody,
.listHover tr,
.listHover td {
    border-collapse: collapse !important;
}

/* 2. Row hover highlight — every row */
.listHover tbody tr:hover td {
    background-color: color-mix(in srgb, #E6F2FF 85%, white) !important;
    font-weight: bold !important;
    border: 0px solid transparent !important;
    border-top: 0px solid transparent !important;
    border-bottom: 0px solid transparent !important;
    border-top-width: 0px !important;
    border-bottom-width: 0px !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    outline: none !important;
}

/* 2b. Kill dotted focus/active-cell outline on hover */
.listHover tbody tr:hover td,
.listHover tbody tr:hover td:focus,
.listHover tbody tr:hover td *:focus {
    outline: none !important;
    outline-width: 0px !important;
    outline-style: none !important;
    border: none !important;
    border-style: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
}

/* 2c. Focusable child span/div inside the cell */
.listHover tbody tr:hover td > * {
    outline: none !important;
    border: none !important;
}

/* 3. Drop the top border of the next row down while hovering */
.listHover tbody tr:hover + tr td,
.listHover tbody tr:hover + tr td * {
    border-top: 0px solid transparent !important;
    border-top-width: 0px !important;
    border-top-style: none !important;
}

/* 4. Keep tooltip text hidden by default on row hover */
.listHover tbody tr:hover td div.tooltip span.tooltiptext,
.listHover tbody tr:hover td div.tooltip span.tooltiptext2 {
    font-weight: normal !important;
    font-style: normal !important;
    background-color: #f7f5cc !important;
    box-shadow: 3px 3px 3px #333333 !important;
    color: black !important;
    visibility: hidden !important;
}

/* 5. Show tooltip text only when hovering the tooltip div itself */
.listHover tbody tr:hover td div.tooltip:hover span.tooltiptext,
.listHover tbody tr:hover td div.tooltip:hover span.tooltiptext2 {
    visibility: visible !important;
    font-weight: normal !important;
    font-style: normal !important;
    background-color: #f7f5cc !important;
    box-shadow: 3px 3px 3px #333333 !important;
    color: black !important;
}

/* 6. Remove dotted underline/outline on list cell links */
.listHover tbody tr td a,
.listHover tbody tr td a:hover,
.listHover tbody tr td a:focus,
.listHover tbody tr td a:active,
.listHover tbody tr td a:visited {
    text-decoration: none !important;
    text-decoration-style: none !important;
    border-bottom: none !important;
    outline: none !important;
}

/* 7. Kill focus-visible outline on tab/click navigation too */
.listHover tbody tr td:focus-visible,
.listHover tbody tr td *:focus-visible {
    outline: none !important;
}

/* 8. Override Cognos's global keyboard/selection outline (from pat.css) */
#idWorkareaPane .listHover td,
#idWorkareaPane .listHover td:hover,
#idWorkareaPane .listHover tbody tr td,
#idWorkareaPane .listHover tbody tr:hover td,
#idWorkareaPane .listHover tbody tr td * {
    outline: none !important;
}
</style>

sqlQuery.name: SQL2
sqlQuery.sqlText:
DECLARE @Par_Cost VARCHAR(5) = #prompt('Par_Cost','varchar')#
SELECT PEER_DEF_ID, PEER_DEF_DESC, MIN_DATE, MAX_DATE, IA_TIME_RANGE, NUM_MEMBERS , CASE WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST1' THEN AVG_POP_COST_MEMBERS WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST2' THEN AVG_POP_COST2_MEMBERS WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST3' THEN AVG_POP_COST3_MEMBERS END AVG_POP_COST_MEMBERS , CASE WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST1' THEN POP_COST_ACT_TOT WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST2' THEN POP_COST2_ACT_TOT WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST3' THEN POP_COST3_ACT_TOT END POP_COST_ACT_TOT , QUAL_EBM_DEN FROM ( SELECT A.PEER_DEF_ID, PEER_DEF_DESC , convert(date,MIN (IA_TIME_START_DATE)) MIN_DATE , convert (date,MAX (IA_TIME_END_DATE)) MAX_DATE , CONVERT(varchar, MIN(IA_TIME_START_DATE), 107) + ' - ' + CONVERT(varchar, MAX(IA_TIME_END_DATE), 107) IA_TIME_RANGE , COUNT(DISTINCT MEMBER) NUM_MEMBERS , SUM (COST_ACT_TOT) / COUNT(DISTINCT MEMBER) AS AVG_POP_COST_MEMBERS , SUM (COST2_ACT_TOT) / COUNT(DISTINCT MEMBER) AS AVG_POP_COST2_MEMBERS , SUM (COST3_ACT_TOT) / COUNT(DISTINCT MEMBER) AS AVG_POP_COST3_MEMBERS , SUM (COST_ACT_TOT) POP_COST_ACT_TOT , SUM (COST2_ACT_TOT) POP_COST2_ACT_TOT , SUM (COST3_ACT_TOT) POP_COST3_ACT_TOT , QUAL_EBM_DEN
FROM POP_COSTS_POPLEVEL A JOIN MAP_PEER B ON B.PEER_DEF_ID = A.PEER_DEF_ID JOIN MAP_IA_TIME_PNA C ON C.IA_TIME = A.IA_TIME LEFT JOIN (SELECT PEER_DEF_ID, SUM(EBM_DEN) AS QUAL_EBM_DEN FROM QL_PROV_QUAL GROUP BY PEER_DEF_ID) D ON D.PEER_DEF_ID = A.PEER_DEF_ID GROUP BY A.PEER_DEF_ID, PEER_DEF_DESC, QUAL_EBM_DEN )AA ORDER BY PEER_DEF_ID

sqlQuery.name: SQL2
sqlQuery.sqlText:
DECLARE @Par_Cost VARCHAR(5) = #prompt('Par_Cost','varchar')#
SELECT PEER_DEF_ID, PEER_DEF_DESC, PEER_CAT1_ID, MIN_DATE, MAX_DATE, IA_TIME_RANGE, EPI_QTY , CASE WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST1' THEN AVG_EPI_COST WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST2' THEN AVG_EPI_COST2 WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST3' THEN AVG_EPI_COST3 END AVG_EPI_COST , CASE WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST1' THEN EPI_COST_ACT_TOT WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST2' THEN EPI_COST2_ACT_TOT WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST3' THEN EPI_COST3_ACT_TOT END EPI_COST_ACT_TOT , QUAL_EBM_DEN
FROM ( SELECT PEER_DEF_ID, PEER_DEF_DESC, PEER_CAT1_ID , MIN (IA_TIME_START_DATE) MIN_DATE , MAX (IA_TIME_END_DATE) MAX_DATE , CONVERT(VARCHAR, MIN(IA_TIME_START_DATE), 107) + ' - ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, MAX(IA_TIME_END_DATE), 107) IA_TIME_RANGE , SUM (EPI_QTY) EPI_QTY , SUM (EPI_COST_ACT_TOT) / SUM (NULLIF(EPI_QTY,0)) AS AVG_EPI_COST , SUM (EPI_COST2_ACT_TOT) / SUM (NULLIF(EPI_QTY,0)) AS AVG_EPI_COST2 , SUM (EPI_COST3_ACT_TOT) / SUM (NULLIF(EPI_QTY,0)) AS AVG_EPI_COST3 , SUM (EPI_COST_ACT_TOT) EPI_COST_ACT_TOT , SUM (EPI_COST2_ACT_TOT) EPI_COST2_ACT_TOT , SUM (EPI_COST3_ACT_TOT) EPI_COST3_ACT_TOT ,SUM(QUAL_EBM_DEN) QUAL_EBM_DEN
FROM QL_PROV WHERE PEER_CAT1_ID IN (0,1,3,6) AND PEER_CAT2_ID NOT IN (2,7,8,9) GROUP BY PEER_DEF_ID, PEER_DEF_DESC, PEER_CAT1_ID HAVING SUM(EPI_QTY) > 0 )AA

sqlQuery.name: SQL10
sqlQuery.sqlText:
DECLARE @Par_Cost VARCHAR(5) = #prompt('Par_Cost','varchar')#
SELECT A.PEER_DEF_ID, PEER_DEF_DESC , CONVERT(varchar, MIN(IA_TIME_START_DATE), 107) + ' - ' + CONVERT(varchar, MAX(IA_TIME_END_DATE), 107) IA_TIME_RANGE , SUM(PEG_EPI_QTY) PEG_EPI_QTY , SUM(CASE WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST1' THEN PEG_EPI_COST_ACT_TOT WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST2' THEN PEG_EPI_COST2_ACT_TOT WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST3' THEN PEG_EPI_COST3_ACT_TOT END) AS PEG_EPI_COST_ACT_TOT , CASE WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST1' THEN SUM(PEG_EPI_COST_ACT_TOT) / SUM(PEG_EPI_QTY) WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST2' THEN SUM(PEG_EPI_COST2_ACT_TOT) / SUM(PEG_EPI_QTY) WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST3' THEN SUM(PEG_EPI_COST3_ACT_TOT) / SUM(PEG_EPI_QTY) END AS COST_PER_PEG_EPI
FROM PROV_EFF_EPI_PEG A INNER JOIN MAP_IA_TIME_PNA B ON B.IA_TIME = A.IA_TIME INNER JOIN MAP_PEER C ON C.PEER_DEF_ID = A.PEER_DEF_ID
GROUP BY A.PEER_DEF_ID, PEER_DEF_DESC

sqlQuery.name: SQL7
sqlQuery.sqlText:
DECLARE @Par_Cost VARCHAR(5) = #prompt('Par_Cost','varchar')#
SELECT PEER_DEF_ID, PEER_DEF_DESC, MIN_DATE, MAX_DATE, IA_TIME_RANGE, NUM_ADMITS , CASE WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST1' THEN AVG_COST_ADMIT WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST2' THEN AVG_COST2_ADMIT WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST3' THEN AVG_COST3_ADMIT END AVG_COST_ADMIT , CASE WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST1' THEN COST_ACT_TOT WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST2' THEN COST2_ACT_TOT WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST3' THEN COST3_ACT_TOT END COST_ACT_TOT FROM ( SELECT PEER_DEF_ID, PEER_DEF_DESC , CONVERT(DATE,MIN (IA_TIME_START_DATE)) MIN_DATE , CONVERT (DATE,MAX (IA_TIME_END_DATE)) MAX_DATE , CONVERT(VARCHAR, MIN(IA_TIME_START_DATE), 107) + ' - ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, MAX(IA_TIME_END_DATE), 107) IA_TIME_RANGE , SUM (ADMIT_ACT_TOT) NUM_ADMITS , SUM (COST_ACT_TOT) / SUM (NULLIF(ADMIT_ACT_TOT,0)) AS AVG_COST_ADMIT , SUM (COST2_ACT_TOT) / SUM (NULLIF(ADMIT_ACT_TOT,0)) AS AVG_COST2_ADMIT , SUM (COST3_ACT_TOT) / SUM (NULLIF(ADMIT_ACT_TOT,0)) AS AVG_COST3_ADMIT , SUM (COST_ACT_TOT) COST_ACT_TOT , SUM (COST2_ACT_TOT) COST2_ACT_TOT , SUM (COST3_ACT_TOT) COST3_ACT_TOT FROM QL_PROV_FAC_INFO GROUP BY PEER_DEF_ID, PEER_DEF_DESC ) AA

sqlQuery.name: SQL9
sqlQuery.sqlText:
SELECT CASE WHEN PROV_AFFIL_LV1_ID = '1' THEN PROV_AFFIL_LV1_ID WHEN PROV_AFFIL_LV2_ID = '2' THEN PROV_AFFIL_LV2_ID ELSE PROV_AFFIL END AS P_LEVEL
FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT(CASE WHEN PROV_AFFIL_LV1_ID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS PROV_AFFIL_LV1_ID, (CASE WHEN PROV_AFFIL_LV2_ID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 2 END) AS PROV_AFFIL_LV2_ID, (CASE WHEN PROV_AFFIL IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 3 END) AS PROV_AFFIL FROM MAP_PROV_AFFIL ) A

sqlQuery.name: SQL11
sqlQuery.sqlText:
SELECT TOP 10 CAST(A.PEER_DEF_ID AS VARCHAR(10)) PEER_DEF_ID, PEER_DEF_DESC, BASE_ETG, BASE_DESC , SUM(EPI_QTY) TOT_EPI_QTY , CONCAT (BASE_DESC,' | ', PEER_DEF_DESC) AS BASE_PEER_DEF_DESC , SUM(CASE WHEN #prompt('Par_Cost','varchar')# = 'COST1' AND COST_FIELD = 'COST1' THEN COST_VAR_TOT WHEN #prompt('Par_Cost','varchar')# = 'COST2' AND COST_FIELD = 'COST2' THEN COST_VAR_TOT WHEN #prompt('Par_Cost','varchar')# = 'COST3' AND COST_FIELD = 'COST3' THEN COST_VAR_TOT END) AS 'Excess Cost Above Expected'
FROM ETG_OPP_SUMMARY A INNER JOIN MAP_PEER B ON B.PEER_DEF_ID = A.PEER_DEF_ID INNER JOIN MAP_ETG_BASE C ON C.BASE = A.BASE_ETG INNER JOIN MAP_IA_TIME_PNA D ON D.IA_TIME = A.IA_TIME WHERE IA_TIME_CODE = 'CP' AND OE_RANGE in (3,4) AND COST_FIELD = #prompt('Par_Cost','varchar','''COST1''')# GROUP BY A.PEER_DEF_ID, PEER_DEF_DESC, BASE_ETG, BASE_DESC ORDER BY SUM(COST_VAR_TOT) DESC

sqlQuery.name: SQL12
sqlQuery.sqlText:
DECLARE @Par_Cost VARCHAR(20) = #prompt('Par_Cost','varchar')#
SELECT TOP 10 CAST(PEER_DEF_ID AS VARCHAR(10)) PEER_DEF_ID, PEER_DEF_DESC, PEG_CAT_ID, PEG_CAT_DESC , SUM(PEG_EPI_COUNT) PEG_EPI_COUNT , CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST1' THEN COST1_OBSERVED WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST2' THEN COST2_OBSERVED WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST3' THEN COST3_OBSERVED END) > SUM(CASE WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST1' THEN COST1_EXPECTED WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST2' THEN COST2_EXPECTED WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST3' THEN COST3_EXPECTED END) THEN SUM(CASE WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST1' THEN COST1_OBSERVED WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST2' THEN COST2_OBSERVED WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST3' THEN COST3_OBSERVED END) - SUM(CASE WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST1' THEN COST1_EXPECTED WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST2' THEN COST2_EXPECTED WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST3' THEN COST3_EXPECTED END) ELSE 0 END AS EXCESS_COST_ABOVE_EXPECTED
FROM ( SELECT A.PEER_DEF_ID, PEER_DEF_DESC, B.PEG_CAT_ID, PEG_CAT_DESC, PROVIDER_ID , SUM(PEG_EPI_QTY) AS PEG_EPI_COUNT , SUM(COST_ACT_TOT) AS COST1_OBSERVED , SUM(COST2_ACT_TOT) AS COST2_OBSERVED, SUM(COST3_ACT_TOT) AS COST3_OBSERVED , SUM(COST_PEER_TOT) AS COST1_EXPECTED, SUM(COST2_PEER_TOT) AS COST2_EXPECTED, SUM(COST3_PEER_TOT) AS COST3_EXPECTED , CASE WHEN SUM(COST_ACT_TOT) > SUM(COST_PEER_TOT) THEN SUM(COST_ACT_TOT) - SUM(COST_PEER_TOT) ELSE 0 END AS EXCESS_COST_ABOVE_EXPECTED , CASE WHEN SUM(COST2_ACT_TOT) > SUM(COST2_PEER_TOT) THEN SUM(COST2_ACT_TOT) - SUM(COST2_PEER_TOT) ELSE 0 END AS EXCESS_COST2_ABOVE_EXPECTED , CASE WHEN SUM(COST3_ACT_TOT) > SUM(COST3_PEER_TOT) THEN SUM(COST3_ACT_TOT) - SUM(COST3_PEER_TOT) ELSE 0 END AS EXCESS_COST3_ABOVE_EXPECTED FROM PEG_EPI_COSTS_EPILEVEL A INNER JOIN PEG_EPISODES B ON B.PEG_EPISODE_ID = A.PEG_EPISODE_ID INNER JOIN MAP_PEER C ON C.PEER_DEF_ID = A.PEER_DEF_ID INNER JOIN MAP_PEG D ON D.PEG_CAT_ID = B.PEG_CAT_ID INNER JOIN MAP_IA_TIME_PNA E ON E.IA_TIME = A.IA_TIME WHERE E.IA_TIME_CODE = 'CP' GROUP BY A.PEER_DEF_ID, PEER_DEF_DESC, B.PEG_CAT_ID, PEG_CAT_DESC, PROVIDER_ID HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST1' THEN COST_ACT_TOT WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST2' THEN COST2_ACT_TOT WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST3' THEN COST3_ACT_TOT END) > SUM(CASE WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST1' THEN COST_PEER_TOT WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST2' THEN COST2_PEER_TOT WHEN @Par_Cost = 'COST3' THEN COST3_PEER_TOT END) )AA
GROUP BY PEER_DEF_ID, PEER_DEF_DESC, PEG_CAT_ID, PEG_CAT_DESC
ORDER BY EXCESS_COST_ABOVE_EXPECTED DESC

sqlQuery.name: SQL1
sqlQuery.sqlText: SELECT CAST(SUM(ER_UTIL) AS NUMERIC) OVR_ED_VISITS , CASE WHEN #prompt('Par_Cost','varchar')# = 'COST1' THEN SUM(COST1) WHEN #prompt('Par_Cost','varchar')# = 'COST2' THEN SUM(COST2) WHEN #prompt('Par_Cost','varchar')# = 'COST3' THEN SUM(COST3) END AS TOT_COST , SUM(ACS_POT_AVOID) AS ACS_POT_AVOID , SUM(LCS_POT_AVOID) AS LCS_POT_AVOID FROM S5_ED_VISITS A WHERE IA_TIME_CODE = 'CP'

sqlQuery.name: SQL8
sqlQuery.sqlText:
SELECT SUM(TOT_ADMIT) TOT_ADMIT , SUM(CASE WHEN #prompt('Par_Cost','varchar')# = 'COST1' THEN COST1 WHEN #prompt('Par_Cost','varchar')# = 'COST2' THEN COST2 WHEN #prompt('Par_Cost','varchar')# = 'COST3' THEN COST3 END) TOT_COST , SUM (NUM_AVOID_ADMIT) AS NUM_AVOID_ADMIT , SUM (NUM_NONAVOID_ADMIT) AS NUM_NONAVOID_ADMIT , SUM(LOS) LOS , SUM(LOS) / NULLIF(SUM(TOT_ADMIT),0) AS ALOS , SUM(TOT_READMIT_07) AS TOT_READMIT_07 , SUM(POT_READMIT_07) POT_READMIT_07 , SUM(TOT_READMIT_30) AS TOT_READMIT_30 , SUM(POT_READMIT_30) POT_READMIT_30
FROM S5_AVOID_ADMIT_READMIT WHERE IA_TIME_CODE = 'CP'

sqlQuery.name: SQL13
sqlQuery.sqlText:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CP_PMPM DESC) CP_PMPM_RANK FROM ( SELECT COST.ACCOUNT_LV1_ID, ACCOUNT_LV1_DESC, SEX AS Gender, (CASE WHEN #prompt('Par_Cost', 'string')# = 'COST1' THEN ISNULL (CASE WHEN CP_MM = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(COST1_TOT_CP) OVER (PARTITION BY COST.ACCOUNT_LV1_ID) / CP_MM END,0) WHEN #prompt('Par_Cost', 'string')# = 'COST2' THEN ISNULL (CASE WHEN CP_MM = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(COST2_TOT_CP) OVER (PARTITION BY COST.ACCOUNT_LV1_ID) / CP_MM END,0) WHEN #prompt('Par_Cost', 'string')# = 'COST3' THEN ISNULL (CASE WHEN CP_MM = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(COST3_TOT_CP) OVER (PARTITION BY COST.ACCOUNT_LV1_ID) / CP_MM END,0) END) AS CP_PMPM,
(CASE WHEN #prompt('Par_Cost', 'string')# = 'COST1' THEN ISNULL (CASE WHEN CP_MM = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (COST1_TOT) / MM END,0) WHEN #prompt('Par_Cost', 'string')# = 'COST2' THEN ISNULL (CASE WHEN CP_MM = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (COST2_TOT) / MM END,0) WHEN #prompt('Par_Cost', 'string')# = 'COST3' THEN ISNULL (CASE WHEN CP_MM = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (COST3_TOT) / MM END,0) END) AS COST_PMPM
FROM ( SELECT ACCOUNT_LV1_ID, ACCOUNT_LV1_DESC, SEX, SUM(COST1_TOT) COST1_TOT, SUM(COST2_TOT) COST2_TOT, SUM(COST3_TOT) COST3_TOT, SUM(COST1_TOT_CP) COST1_TOT_CP, SUM(COST2_TOT_CP) COST2_TOT_CP, SUM(COST3_TOT_CP) COST3_TOT_CP FROM S5_COST_UTIL_ACCOUNT GROUP BY ACCOUNT_LV1_ID, ACCOUNT_LV1_DESC, SEX ) COST
JOIN
(SELECT ACCOUNT_LV1_ID, SUM(CP_MM) AS CP_MM, SUM(NUM_MM) AS MM FROM S5_COST_UTIL_MEMBER_MM GROUP BY ACCOUNT_LV1_ID ) MM ON MM.ACCOUNT_LV1_ID = COST.ACCOUNT_LV1_ID ) A ) B WHERE CP_PMPM_RANK < 6
